hypotheses.paper: « soit U un ouvert de V »
hypotheses.note: U connected (IsPreconnected) and nonempty, consistent with « variété » connected; for 1° and the uniqueness in 2°; 2°'s existence holds for every U (exists_compatibleChart_jet)
IsAnalyticAction G X; instances for GSR n (wave 1) and GAR n (here)

questions: Uniqueness in 2° is up to OpenPartialHomeomorph.EqOnSource (equal on U), since an OpenPartialHomeomorph carries values outside its source.
remarks: Not a finding (DEC-120 reads « ouvert U » connected and nonempty). Read literally, Prop. 1 (benzecri1960_ch1.tex:340–350) fails for a disconnected open U: in the locally affine manifold ℝ¹, U = {y < 1} ∪ {y > 2} carries two compatible charts — the identity, and the identity on {y < 1} glued to the translation by 10 on {y > 2} — which differ by no single g ∈ GA(1, ℝ) (1° fails) and have the same jet at 0 without being equal on U (uniqueness in 2° fails): not_prop1_of_disconnected (auxiliary objects in namespace Benzecri.Prop1Counterexample). And for U = ∅ the uniqueness of g in 1° fails as soon as G ≠ 1: not_existsUnique_smul_eq_of_empty.

hypotheses.paper: f_i = g_ij ∘ f_j on all of U_i ∩ U_j
hypotheses.note: near each point of U_i ∩ U_j suffices; the printed form is the corollary existsUnique_structure_of_atlas_printed
